task.title: Automate Audio File Transfer From Recorder to iCloud

user_message.content:
The user has a Disoidoe 136GB Magnetic Voice Recorder that mounts as a USB drive called "ROSE-REC" when plugged into their MacBook.

They want a workflow where when they plug in the recorder (ROSE-REC mounts), new audio files are automatically copied from the recorder to their iCloud folder at: ~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Recordings Vault/Inbox/

Please create:
1. A macOS LaunchAgent plist file that watches for /Volumes/ROSE-REC to appear
2. A shell script that the LaunchAgent triggers, which:
   - Copies all audio files (.mp3, .wav, .m4a, .wma, .flac) from /Volumes/ROSE-REC (and subdirectories like /RECORD/) to the Inbox folder
   - Only copies files that aren't already in the Inbox (to avoid duplicates)
   - Logs what it copied
3. Clear step-by-step installation instructions for the user to set this up on their Mac

Write all files and provide the complete setup guide as a markdown document. Make the scripts robust and well-commented.

assistant_message.content:
Here are all three files for your ROSE-REC automation. Below is a summary of how everything works together, followed by the complete file contents.

---

## How It Works

The system uses two macOS-native mechanisms:

| Component | File | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Shell Script | `auto_copy_audio.sh` | Performs the copy, deduplication, and logging |
| LaunchAgent | `com.user.roserec.sync.plist` | Watches `/Volumes` and triggers the script on mount |

The LaunchAgent uses `WatchPaths` on `/Volumes`, which is the macOS-native way to react to USB drive events without polling or third-party software. When the recorder mounts, the script wakes up, checks for `ROSE-REC` specifically, and uses `find` with `-iname` (case-insensitive) to locate all `.mp3`, `.wav`, `.m4a`, `.wma`, and `.flac` files anywhere on the drive — including subdirectories like `/RECORD/`. It then checks each file against the destination before copying, so re-plugging the recorder never creates duplicates.

---

## File Contents

### `auto_copy_audio.sh`

```bash
#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# Script: auto_copy_audio.sh
# Description: Automatically copies new audio files from ROSE-REC to iCloud
# ==============================================================================

# Define variables
SOURCE_DIR="/Volumes/ROSE-REC"
DEST_DIR="$HOME/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Recordings Vault/Inbox"
LOG_FILE="$HOME/Library/Logs/ROSE-REC-Sync.log"

# Log function
log_msg() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - $1" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

# Give the system a moment to fully mount the drive
sleep 2

# Check if source directory exists
if [ ! -d "$SOURCE_DIR" ]; then
    # Exit silently if the drive isn't mounted
    exit 0
fi

log_msg "ROSE-REC detected. Starting sync..."

# Ensure destination directory exists
mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"

# Find all audio files and copy them if they don't exist in destination
# Using find with case-insensitive matching for common audio extensions
count=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    filename=$(basename "$file")
    dest_path="$DEST_DIR/$filename"

    # Check if file already exists in destination
    if [ ! -f "$dest_path" ]; then
        # Copy the file
        cp "$file" "$dest_path"
        log_msg "Copied: $filename"
        ((count++))
    fi
done < <(find "$SOURCE_DIR" -type f \( -iname "*.mp3" -o -iname "*.wav" -o -iname "*.m4a" -o -iname "*.wma" -o -iname "*.flac" \) -print0)

log_msg "Sync complete. $count new file(s) copied."
log_msg "----------------------------------------"
```

---

### `com.user.roserec.sync.plist`

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
    <key>Label</key>
    <string>com.user.roserec.sync</string>

    <key>ProgramArguments</key>
    <array>
        <string>/bin/bash</string>
        <string>-c</string>
        <string>$HOME/Scripts/auto_copy_audio.sh</string>
    </array>

    <key>WatchPaths</key>
    <array>
        <string>/Volumes</string>
    </array>

    <key>RunAtLoad</key>
    <false/>

    <key>StandardOutPath</key>
    <string>/tmp/com.user.roserec.sync.stdout</string>

    <key>StandardErrorPath</key>
    <string>/tmp/com.user.roserec.sync.stderr</string>
</dict>
</plist>
```

---

See the attached files for the complete setup guide and all ready-to-use files. The guide walks through every step including the critical **Full Disk Access** permission that macOS requires for background scripts to access USB drives and iCloud.
